elaborate headdress/headgear at top of figure
disc or rosette ornament on the body

justification: Both show a single dominant anthropomorphic figure wearing a headdress, with a circular disc-like ornament on the chest area and a banded belt/garment edge across the waist, and in both the figure fills the whole field with the head at top. But A is a detailed profile relief of a winged, bird-headed being actively holding a bucket and raising a hand, whereas B is a frontal, blocky, largely featureless figure with no wings, no bird head and no held objects, rendered in far more schematic and volumetric conventions.
